title: CPSO dt statistically independent selection campaign, Mac M2
description: Prespecified 16-candidate selection stage after 100-point exploratory screen. Uses 30 fresh paired seeds, unchanged CPSO native engine, fixed FE budget; a separate held-out validation is mandatory for final dt selection.
analysis_protocol: Equal-weight average over 12 problem/dimension strata of per-run log10 residual fraction relative to initial best; paired seed resampling; independent held-out validation after selection.
